implementation: All rows from one protein are held out together in each of 15 outer folds.
required_interpretation_or_action: Evaluation is protein-held-out within this 15-protein panel, not external validation.

implementation: StandardScaler is fit only on outer-training proteins and applied unchanged to the held-out protein.
required_interpretation_or_action: No preprocessing leakage was found for the locked models.

implementation: L2 logistic regression with C=1.0, class_weight=balanced, lbfgs, max_iter=100, tol=1e-4.
required_interpretation_or_action: C was inherited/fixed, not selected by evidence from an inner loop.

implementation: No model hyperparameters are tuned; therefore no inner tuning loop is needed for the reported fixed model.
evidence: No GridSearchCV, RandomizedSearchCV, or training-fold selection in scripts 22/24/25/27.
required_interpretation_or_action: Future tuning must occur entirely inside an inner training-only loop.

implementation: Continue when outer-LOPO probability is >=0.5; stop otherwise.
required_interpretation_or_action: The threshold was not selected to guarantee a false-stop ceiling; do not call it false-stop-controlled.

implementation: Every locked p=0.5 policy decision is derived from an outer-LOPO probability for that row.
evidence: locked_lopo_fold and locked_lopo_probability_retained are nonmissing for all 52 policy rows.
required_interpretation_or_action: The threshold sweep remains retrospective and does not constitute prospective control.

implementation: The 20 ns checkpoint was historically motivated by the existing short-MD screen, but coordinate controls and 5/10/15/30 ns comparisons were examined retrospectively after outcome access.
evidence: scripts 22 then 24; repository timestamps support ordering, but no preregistration or committed history proves prospective specification.
required_interpretation_or_action: Do not claim that 20 ns or the feature set was selected by nested validation. Treat alternatives as secondary exploration.

implementation: The class-weighted logistic predict_proba output has no Platt, isotonic, or other calibration step and is treated as a model score.
evidence: No calibration estimator is present in scripts 22/24/25/27.
required_interpretation_or_action: Do not interpret the score as an absolute probability of late retention.

implementation: LOPO produces 15 fold-specific evaluation models. No final all-development-protein deployment model is generated here.
evidence: One held-out-protein model per fold; no serialized final model artifact.
required_interpretation_or_action: After the procedure is frozen, train a separate final candidate and test it in a prospective shadow study.

implementation: Intervals use 5000 protein-clustered draws of fixed continuous scores or saved OOF predictions; models are not refit per draw.
required_interpretation_or_action: Intervals quantify clustered sampling variation conditional on the fitted OOF scores, not full pipeline-selection uncertainty.
